title: Continental GT 650 British Racing Green (Race Replica)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Royal Enfield Continental GT 650 British Racing Green (Race Replica) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 193 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
